description: This Java class `LoanRescheduleRequestStatusEnumData` defines an immutable data object representing different statuses of a loan rescheduling request, such as pending approval, approved, or rejected. It encapsulates status details with related methods, primarily used within the loan rescheduling workflow of the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequestStatusEnumData
classes.description: Immutable data class representing loan reschedule request status enumeration with status flags.

methods.name: LoanRescheduleRequestStatusEnumData
methods.description: Constructor initializing status fields and setting flags based on loan status values.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the status.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the status.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the display value of the status.

methods.name: isPendingApproval
methods.description: Indicates if the status is pending approval.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Indicates if the status is approved.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Indicates if the status is rejected.
